map.Bcrypt 不是加密，无法解密，只能校验: Bcrypt is not encryption and cannot be decrypted; it can only verify
map.Bcrypt 是密码存储的主流哈希算法，内置盐值（salt），相同明文每次结果不: Bcrypt is the mainstream hashing algorithm for password storage; it embeds a salt, so the same plaintext gives a different result each time. This tool generates hashes and verifies plaintext, with an adjustable cost factor (rounds), computed entirely in the browser.
map.Bcrypt 每次生成随机盐，盐值写入哈希前缀，所以结果不同但都可校验。: Bcrypt generates a random salt each time and stores it in the hash prefix, so results differ yet all remain verifiable.
